title: Bird Base Petal Fold Crease Inversion Sequence
summary: Transform square paper base through precision preliminary folds into the inverted petal fold bird base.

claims.statement: Step 1: Crease diagonal valley folds and orthogonal mountain folds, then collapse into a 1/4 size preliminary square with open corner facing learner.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Crease diagonal valley folds and orthogonal mountain folds, then collapse into a 1/4 size preliminary square with open corner facing learner.

claims.statement: Step 2: Lift top flap upward while simultaneously reversing lateral mountain creases into valley folds along the central symmetry axis.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Lift top flap upward while simultaneously reversing lateral mountain creases into valley folds along the central symmetry axis.
